title: Auto-Policy, not Auto-Skill: Compiled Agent Skills for the Physical World
abstract: arXiv:2608.25091v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Self-evolving Skill harnesses automatically rewrite an agent's procedural knowledge to improve efficiency, yet leave execution authority unconstrained. A Skill specifies how an agent should act, whereas a policy decides which requests may become physical actions; current Skill formats package procedure as markdown and scripts and leave authorization to the model. This gap is critical when a wrong invocation unlocks a door. We term the resulting failure Borrowed Authority: an inter-agent message pairs an instruction with an unverifiable permission claim, and the receiving Skill has no typed way to reject it. Across six open-weight receiver configurations (9,510 episodes), models execute 87% of unauthorized requests with no rule, 91% under a one-line rule, 25% when given the full policy in prose and a state-reading tool, and 18% behind a dedicated LLM checker. translated_title: 自主策略，而非自主技能：面向物理世界的编译式智能体技能
translated_abstract: 自进化技能框架会自动重写智能体的程序性知识以提升效率，但使执行权限处于不受约束的状态。技能规定智能体应当如何行动，而策略决定哪些请求可以转化为物理动作；当前的技能格式以 Markdown 和脚本的形式封装流程，并将授权决策留给模型。当一次错误的调用足以打开一扇门时，这一差距便至关重要。我们将由此产生的故障称为“借用的权限”：智能体间的消息将指令与一个无法验证的权限声明配对，而接收方技能没有任何类型化的方式来拒绝它。在六种开放权重接收配置（共9,510个回合）的实验中，模型在无规则约束时执行了87%的未授权请求，在单行规则下执行91%，在提供完整策略散文描述及状态读取工具时执行25%，在专用LLM检查器防护下执行18%。失败集中在近似错误上（如大小写变体、空格、通配符、省略……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了“借用的权限”这一安全漏洞——当前智能体技能格式下模型会执行高达91%的未授权物理世界请求，并提出技能与策略必须分离、应通过编译式技能将授权策略内建于智能体之中以保障物理世界安全。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the "Borrowed Authority" vulnerability—where agent skills execute up to 91% of unauthorized physical-world requests—and argues that policy must be separated from skill through compiled agent skills that enforce authorization policies by construction.
